title: Plumeform glass card (v2)
description: A dark frosted card for the bands: 28px corners, a faint white top-to-bottom sheen, a hairline white border, an inner top highlight and a long soft drop. Reveals on scroll with an optional stagger step.
notes: made for dark sections (wrap the section in the dark class); on light themes it reads as a faint grey card
name: plumeform-v2-glass-card

props.name: as
props.description: the element to render (div by default; li inside lists)

props.name: step
props.description: stagger position when cards sit in a row
